decision.direction: after>before =>LONG; after<before =>SHORT; otherwise NO_TRADE. No candle return, volume surprise, funding sign, regime, rank or winner-derived trigger.
decision.entry_time: Exactly T-6h, on a30s UTC grid; if T does not align, reject rather than round. One IOC may be submitted during [T-6h,T-6h+2000ms), using a genuinely post250ms latency book. Deadline/no-fill/partial never authorizes chasing or a second opening.
decision.priority: Protective stop/integrity amendment reduction before target, then fixed time. Reduce-only intents are durable, including earliest actual book receipt needed for each250ms attempt. No pre-latency book replay.
decision.reference: Entry reference is genuine latest executable ask for LONG / bid for SHORT observed at decision. Freeze absolute stop and target BEFORE submission. Actual average fill/quantity and resulting reward/risk are recorded; never relocate stop or target to manufacture the prescribed R.
decision.selection: Group all rows and different effective times from one notice as one event batch. At each entry epoch sort canonical native market keys; choose first candidate passing all unchanged independent risk/venue/margin/minimum-notional and trial gates. At most one opening submission per event batch, even if unfilled; one pending/open trial-wide. Other rows remain capacity/risk rejected, not missing.
decision.setting_basis: 100bp risk stop and200bp target are unoptimized2:1 protective geometry for a slow policy event, not estimates of impact. They were not selected from winner medians or event returns; financial loss limits and the fixed event clock constrain the trial.
decision.stop: LONG E*(1-.01); SHORT E*(1+.01), using pre-submission executable E. Protective fresh-mark trigger and executable-price crossing both latch stop; no trailing/breakeven/extension. Stop is risk protection, not proof the fundamental hypothesis is false.
decision.target: LONG E*(1+.02); SHORT E*(1-.02). Trigger only from genuine fresh executable liquidation quote; no candle high/low fill assumptions.
decision.time_exit: T+6h latches full reduction (12h scheduled exposure). Trigger is not guaranteed exit/fill; partial/no-fill retries remain active across restart and entry suspension.

evaluation.T0: Unassigned; no activation. Before observations, independent immutable activation receipt must bind codeSHA, this protocolSHA, actual fresh IDs/roots/$10000+$10000, source/clock/gap/identity/host/resource evidence, execution/cost/risk and fixed future T0>=release+6h. No backdating or date movement after outcomes.
evaluation.chronology: 90day thirds[0,30,60,90]days; contingent180day thirds[0,60,120,180]. Preserve original fixed30day blocks. Equity at exact boundaries with original marks, funding and open exposures, not closure-count partitions. Missing boundary mark/cash is UNKNOWN.
evaluation.diagnostics: Record opportunities/signals/admission/rejections/submissions/fills/misses, eachgross/fees/funding/realized/unrealized/equity/drawdown/exposure and source status. Report side/market/batch concentration, largest winner and leave-one-market/batch removal. Unaffected-market same-clock returns are diagnostic ONLY, not fabricated funded hedges or substitute for cash control. No hyperparameter search or automatic retraining.
evaluation.economics: Strictly positive absolute whole marked after-all-cost equity above10000 and advantage over NO_TRADE; strictly positive marked net change in each frozen elapsed third; peak-to-trough marked drawdown<=.5%. At least72h complete authentic prospective source AND complete required observation throughout every lifecycle and review-boundary valuation. All sample/source/account conditions necessary, never sufficient causal proof. The0.5%peak-to-trough gate is qualification, distinct from the fixed9950entry-disable floor; crossing either preserves all losses and restrictions.
evaluation.horizon: Review T0+90calendar days. One unchanged extension toT0+180 only for insufficient predetermined sample counts, independent of PnL, provided no integrity failure/permanent shutdown. Source failure is a failure, not an extension excuse. Adequate-sample economic failure cannot extend. Preserve original90day verdict;180 insufficient is final INCONCLUSIVE.
evaluation.inference: Fixed7day calendar blocks anchoredT0: B=13 for90days (last block6days), B=26 for180days (last5days). Assign whole connected-component returns by firstfill, preserving empty blocks. For5000replicates use ONE random.Random(1258) instance; each replicate draws exactlyB indices independently with rng.randrange(B), concatenates all component-return lists from drawn blocks with multiplicity, statistic=sum(returns)/len(returns). A zero-component or UNKNOWN replicate invalidates inference, never discarded. Sort all5000means ascending; zero-based index249 one-sided95% lower bound must>0. Nominal95% does not guarantee coverage with few dependent/nonstationary blocks. No post-review cash/outcome may enter a review replicate.
evaluation.review_boundary: Allow entry only if scheduled T+6h<=the currently frozen review end (T0+90d initially, T0+180d only after permitted extension). Full component cash return is sum of all constituent actual realized gross minus all entry/exit fees plus all authentic settled funding, divided by whole-account equity immediately BEFORE the component first fill. All actual reductions and funding must be finalized from information received by review end; an open/right-censored component, failed exit extending beyond end or unresolved funding is UNKNOWN and prevents complete-lifecycle inference. Never drop it or import later outcomes into an earlier review. Preserve exact-boundary marked-account result and continue protection. Count-only extension cannot repair a source/funding failure; no old90d verdict is rewritten.
evaluation.sample: At least20 completed independently observed common-shock components,5 executed native markets,5 LONG and5 SHORT components and5 components assigned by first-fill in each elapsed-time third. Notices sharing effective time or whose [entry,T+6h] windows overlap are one connected common-shock component; one notice is one batch despite many assets. No claim that nonoverlap proves independence. Classify a connected component LONG only if all actual entries are LONG, SHORT only if all are SHORT, otherwise MIXED; MIXED counts once overall and toward neither directional minimum.

event.T: Announced UTC rollout START, not assumed completion. Preserve disclosed rollout range.
event.exclude: Cross-Margin-only, Portfolio-Margin-Pro-only, tiered/ambiguous table, leverage-only, stablecoin, wrapped/synthetic/redemption claim, mixed listing/delisting treatment in SAME notice, ambiguous underlying, unsupported native perp or missing native eligibility. Do not assert all other world news is absent; known concurrent news is retained as a confounder.
event.first_receipt: Complete original semantic body/table must be durably first received by T-7h, after immutable trial activation T0; original publication/update text is preserved but never substituted for first receipt.
event.identity: Authoritative exchange asset/token identification must match the native Hyperliquid underlying; equal ticker alone is insufficient. Native namespace empty only; ordinary support/eligibility unchanged.
event.materiality_pp: Absolute after-minus-before >=10 percentage points. At unchanged prices +10pp recognizes $100 more collateral per $1000 qualifying holding, NOT $100 profit or a 1000bp price prediction.
event.population: Every captured candidate notice, every row and every exclusion, late/unknown/amended/cancelled/non-native/ineligible/capacity/risk/no-fill result is retained. This is a prospective captured-notice cohort, NOT a claim of complete historical/global announcement census. Missing scheduled source check creates a gap and blocks new exposure.
event.revisions: Capture original body, original receive clock, ordinal, URL, published/updated text and semantic digest of identity/product/ratios/T/rollout. Reverify same semantic fields with a fresh official response received within60s before entry. Footer/navigation-only changes are not amendments. A material amendment or conflicting/missing verification cancels new entry permanently for this event; never move its entry clock. Material amendment discovered while held latches protective full reduction on a genuine post-latency fresh book; preserve original T and all outcomes.
event.sampling: Ordinary official announcement index and already known candidate notices may be checked on a fixed15min UTC schedule only after source/resource admission; no new collector is authorized by this protocol. Save complete index response and covered page/cursor boundary; missing/truncated/ambiguous coverage is UNKNOWN. Near-entry verification above is additional. No current process implements these checks.
event.source: Original English Binance official announcement with complete body and canonical URL; flat ordinary Portfolio Margin before/after collateral ratios; no social reposts or inferred events.

execution.accounting: Fill prices already incorporate spread/impact; do not subtract them twice. Book actual fees and funding; include open marked positions, margin, all reductions and cash reconciliation. Unfilled orders have no fictitious fees or PnL.
execution.cost_reserve_bps: c=9 + latest full spread_bp +10 +13*abs(current hourly funding rate)*10000. This is conservative decision/risk reserve, not a prediction/bound. Require c<=50bp and full spread<=5bp;200bp target thus>=4*c before fill movement. Preserve stricter independent risk cost envelope.
execution.funding: Actual position quantity and authentic pre-boundary oracle determine actual settled hourly cash once, including partial exits and funding received after close. Unknown cash/source is UNKNOWN, blocks new entries and prevents qualification; never zero-impute.
execution.inputs: No signed tape or continuous full-depth history is a signal input. Genuine native metadata/context, closed candles where ordinary eligibility requires them, fresh full native L2 for sizing/fills, marks, hourly settled funding/oracle and original account/source/gap evidence are still mandatory for execution/qualification. Do not reconstruct depth/trades from candles or use later-retrieved history as prospective first receipt.
execution.reuse: Pinned main6d1fa4d9f33cba236057c8cea83312f7f4089dcd ordinary native eligibility, risk engine, paper planner/IOC/accounting and funding functions; independently reviewed new policy binding/launcher still required. Existing FlowPaperTrial is specifically bound to flow v1 and MUST NOT run this protocol by relabeling its identity/hash.
execution.settings: Paper only,250ms latency,25bp IOC cap, genuine book received after latency, latest receipt AND exchange ages<=1000ms at attempt; unchanged ordinary mark/eligibility/venue/health gates. No assumed executable quote between books. Every missed/partial/failed exit and excess loss is preserved.

flow_v1: SHELVED_OPERATIONALLY_DATA_BLOCKED, economics not disproved; original protocolSHA c248746bbe4cd36fa63233b32bd643e368f2d20c63b0e973cf39ffd515873057 and policy/tests unchanged.
forbidden: No paid feed/host/subscription, new collector/general framework, ordinary worker change/restart/duplicate, PR1392 activation, historical loss reset, fabricated source/fill or LIVE execution.
historical_exclusion: ASTER/ETC effective2026-10-16 source example and all pre-T0 notices are excluded from outcome scoring. No event returns were inspected to choose/freeze this policy.
mechanism: An announced change in recognized collateral value may change inventory demand by financing holders. LONG higher utility / SHORT lower utility is an unvalidated directional hypothesis, not compulsory buying/selling or liquidation identification. Existing holders may withdraw spare collateral, add stable collateral, repay or close unrelated positions. Issuer risk and notice selection are confounders.

risk.capacity: One pending/open position; max6 actual openings/UTCday; same market1h cooldown; one attempt per event batch; no averaging/pyramids/martingale.
risk.control: Distinct durable NO_TRADE simulated account; no cash yield; no operational ledgers created.
risk.locks: Marked equity<=9950 permanently disables new entries for v1. Preserve existing daily1%/weekly3%/correlation/margin/three-loss1h cooldown and any stricter risk veto. Gaps may exceed planned loss; no reset/new version to erase losses. All protective exits remain active.
risk.sizing: N<=min(.001*equity/((100+c)/10000),.25*equity,.05*genuine_contra_25bp_notional_depth), round size DOWN to native precision. Existing independent approvals can only reduce/reject; include its stricter entry/exit reserve and actual worst IOC risk. Notional/depth are ceilings, never allocation minima.
